name: zclass_world_remove_light

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x451410 searches the world light node list, shifts light node/data arrays down, decrements world lightCount, searches the light's attachedWorlds list, shifts it down, decrements attachedWorldCount, and reports errors when either side is missing.
